primaryTextRead.text: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good.”

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: L696–702 lists distinct Amariahs; L699 describes the chief priest and judge appointed by Jehoshaphat at 2 Chronicles 19:11.
